basic_details.job_title: UoH Psychological Counselor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The University of Hyderabad is hiring one Psychological Counselor on contract at a consolidated pay of Rs. 55,000 per month, with an initial tenure of 179 days. The post is marked OBC-NCL (Male). Candidates need a Post-Graduation degree in Psychology with specialization in Counseling and a minimum of one year of experience under a Practicing Psychologist, and the age must not exceed 50 years. The hard copy of the application must reach the Recruitment Cell by post or courier on or before 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application format from the University's non-teaching and project staff page, https://uohyd.ac.in/non-teaching-project-staff/. Applications duly filled in all respects will only be accepted.
Fill in the format and enclose self-attested photocopies of the documents that support the entries made in it.

Address the envelope to: The Assistant Registrar, Recruitment Cell, Room no. 221, Administration Building, University of Hyderabad, P.O. Central University, Prof. C.R. Rao Road. Gachibowli Hyderabad-500 046.
Send the complete application by post or courier only, so that it reaches the above address on or before 30 November 2026. The hard copy will not be accepted in person.
Give a valid e-mail ID and mobile number and keep them active, as all communication is sent to them and no other mode of communication is used.
OBC-NCL certificate, which must be included in the Central List and issued in the prescribed Government of India format during Financial Year 2026-27 (issued on or after 01.04.2026).
These documents alone are considered for screening. Originals have to be produced as and when called for interview.
important_instructions: Mere submission of an application gives no right to be called for interview or selection. False or insufficient information, or lack of proof to confirm eligibility, leads to summary rejection at any stage of the selection process. The University reserves the right to upgrade the eligibility criteria if a large number of applications are received. The University reserves the right to fill up or not to fill up the advertised position without assigning any reasons. Candidates who fail to produce the prescribed OBC (NCL) certificate will not be considered for further process. For further details, the notice points to https://uohyd.ac.in/non-teaching-project-staff/.

content_sections.heading: UoH Psychological Counselor at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Initial 179 days, likely to be extended based on performance and requirement
Hard copy by post or courier only

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals can apply. The notice states that the post is for an OBC-NCL (Male) candidate. The qualification and experience must be acquired on or before the last date for receipt of applications, and the qualification must be from approved or recognized institutions. Experience: minimum of one year experience of working under a Practicing Psychologist. Age: not exceeding 50 years. The notice prints no age relaxation and no separate cut-off date for age. For the full eligibility conditions, refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: A Post-Graduation degree in Psychology from a recognized University. The candidate should have done specialization in Counseling. The specialization must include at least one paper in theory and one under practical.
rows.desirable: Ph.D in Psychology or Counseling Psychology from a recognised University.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated pay is Rs. 55,000/- per month. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. The initial engagement is for 179 days from the date of joining, which is likely to be extended based on performance and the requirements of the University. The appointment is purely contractual. It gives no right to claim regular appointment or regularization against any post in the University. Either party may end the engagement by giving one month's notice, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: UoH Psychological Counselor Job Description
content_sections.text: Administer psychological assessments on clients. Maintain case files. Provide counseling to the students who approach the Counselor directly or are referred. Organize regular orientation programmes for the student community. Train a core group of students from different hostels as whistle blowers.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoH Psychological Counselor
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application format from the University's non-teaching and project staff page, https://uohyd.ac.in/non-teaching-project-staff/ . Applications duly filled in all respects will only be accepted. Fill in the format and enclose self-attested photocopies of the documents that support the entries made in it. Address the envelope to: The Assistant Registrar, Recruitment Cell, Room no. 221, Administration Building, University of Hyderabad, P.O. Central University, Prof. C.R. Rao Road. Gachibowli Hyderabad-500 046. Send the complete application by post or courier only, so that it reaches the above address on or before 30 November 2026. The hard copy will not be accepted in person. Give a valid e-mail ID and mobile number and keep them active, as all communication is sent to them and no other mode of communication is used. Documents in support of qualification. Documents in support of experience. Documents in support of age. OBC-NCL certificate, which must be included in the Central List and issued in the prescribed Government of India format during Financial Year 2026-27 (issued on or after 01.04.2026). These documents alone are considered for screening. Originals have to be produced as and when called for interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection may be made on the basis of personal interaction with the candidates, on the recommendations of a selection committee. Call letters and intimations are sent by email to shortlisted candidates. The notice states that no travel entitlement or support is provided for the personal interaction. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UoH Psychological Counselor recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) post of Psychological Counselor, marked OBC-NCL (Male), on contract or temporary basis at the University of Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the UoH Psychological Counselor post?
faq.answer: The complete application must reach the University on or before 30 November 2026, by post or courier only.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for UoH Psychological Counselor?
faq.answer: A Post-Graduation degree in Psychology from a recognized University, with specialization in Counseling that includes at least one theory paper and one practical paper. Minimum one year of experience under a Practicing Psychologist is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for UoH Psychological Counselor?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 50 years, as the notice prints it.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the UoH Psychological Counselor?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 55,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the UoH Psychological Counselor post?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application format and send the hard copy with self-attested photocopies of supporting documents to The Assistant Registrar, Recruitment Cell, Room no. 221, Administration Building, University of Hyderabad, Hyderabad-500 046. The hard copy is not accepted in person.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection may be made on the basis of personal interaction with candidates, on the recommendations of a selection committee. Only the documents enclosed with the application are considered for screening.

faq.question: Q8. Is the UoH Psychological Counselor job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on contract. It starts with a tenure of 179 days from joining, which is likely to be extended based on performance and requirement, and it gives no right to regularization.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel expenses be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No travel entitlement or support will be provided for the personal interaction if a candidate is shortlisted.

faq.question: Q10. Why is an OBC-NCL certificate required?
faq.answer: The post is marked OBC-NCL (Male). The certificate must be in the prescribed Government of India format and issued on or after 01.04.2026, and candidates who fail to produce it will not be considered for further process.
